method: Primary pages opened live or explicit access exception; no procurement. Prices/warehouse status are observations at lookup time, not reservations.

sources.title: ROBOTIS XL330-M288 e-Manual
facts_used: 5V stall 1.47A; standby 17mA; 3.7–6V input
Present Current is input-power current for XL330; Current Limit active in modes 0 and 5
EH pin 1 GND / 2 VDD / 3 DATA; manufacturer 21AWG cable

sources.title: ROBOTIS OpenRB-150 e-Manual
facts_used: all DXL ports combined 3A; USB fuse 500mA
external servo VDD bypass means board power switch cannot turn off external rail

sources.title: Pololu D42V110F5 #5671
facts_used: 5V +/-3%; about 15A curve at 6.6-8.4V in room-temperature still air; conservative review allowance 14A
ENA pulled up to VIN; ground to disable. ENB/PFM left open
low-input dropout about 0.3V or less through 10A; no robot transients measured
unknown_or_not_proven: enclosed temperature and transient response with this battery/harness

sources.title: Pololu #5671 specifications and dimension diagram
facts_used: 43.2x31.8x9mm nominal, 15g

10–20mA quiescent; no configured per-cell battery cutoff
unknown_or_not_proven: this board plus USB cable cannot guarantee Pi >4.8V by worst-case specifications
